purpose: REF01: which patches of patches/winuae/series.json the reference build keeps (tools/build_reference.py). required: the profile does not link or run deterministically without it (host services excluded, portability, clock/seed/pacing replaced by emulated or explicit values, the return at a video unit, the media and device support of a preset). instrumentation: accessors, observers and session hooks that the probe or the bridge read the machine through; the reference keeps them so that both builds are observed the same way. behavior: changes what the engine computes in the profile, or claims to rewrite code without changing its result; the reference omits it ("ablate") and the entry says what its absence is expected to change and the test that backs the patch.

effects.neutral: the patch claims to leave every result unchanged: product and reference must be equal on the named cases (REF01 proves the claim)
effects.inert: the patch only acts after a load, a reset of a used process or on input the REF01 corpus does not contain: product and reference must be equal on the corpus, and the named test is the evidence of the patch
effects.differs: the patch changes the result of the named cases: REF01 expects a difference there, in the subsystems of the entry, and nowhere else

0262-denise-sprite-mask-unsigned-shift.why: The sprite priority mask of expand_bplcon2 is shifted as an unsigned constant (the signed shift of 0xFFFF by up to 20 places is undefined); the mask is cut to 16 bits, so the value is the same.

0020-audio-signed-scaling.why: Left shifts of negative PCM and sinc amplitudes become multiplications (defined in C++17); the patch claims the same scale, rounding and clipping.

0024-cpu-halt-preserve-paula.why: Stock audio_deactivate clears Paula state and phase when the CPU halts; the product keeps Paula running while the chipset clock advances (ADR 0002). Attribution measured on 2026-10-12: re-applying only this patch to the reference tree makes a500-halt-pal equal.

0041-preset-clear-all-ram-boards.why: Stock apply_prefs loop clears slot 0 of the Fast/Z3 board arrays on every pass; a fresh process starts with all boards cleared, so only a reused preference set shows it.

0061-drawing-null-buffer-arithmetic.why: The first video unit draws a line before any buffer is locked: NULL plus a shift and a shift of the negative pixel-count sentinel are undefined; both rewrites keep the values of valid buffers.

0068-disk-head-starts-on-track-0.why: The floppy head starts on track 0 at every load; a clean process has the static array at zero, so only a second load in a used process shows it.

0069-input-pot-state-reset.why: The pot port state (POTGO value, charge model and counters) goes back to zero at every reset; stock WinUAE keeps what the session left in it, so a machine that p6_reset restarted does not start as a cold one. Attribution measured on 2026-10-12: re-applying only this patch to the reference tree makes the reset case equal (a500-vsync-reset3-pal and reset-mid-run-pal).

0072-prefs-copy-owns-device-names.why: Each preference set owns its device names (a leak and a shared string on every load); the values are the same.

0090-custom-restore-on-live-machine.why: restore_custom applies on a live machine (no audio_reset, blitter_reset or preference write); only a state load runs it.

0091-disk-restore-writes-no-preferences.why: restore_disk writes no drive type or floppy count into the preferences; only a state load runs it.

0093-blitter-body-keeps-old-skip-flags.why: restore_blitter_new keeps the old skip flags a type 2 body carries; only a state load runs it.

0096-custom-rga-fourth-slot-state.why: The fourth RGA pipeline slot travels in CHSL; only a state save or load walks the slots.

0102-disk-update-defined-shift.why: The position DISK_update is brought up to is computed with a multiplication, not a left shift of a negative value; only a state load calls DISK_update(-1).

0111-fast-ram-access-mask.why: A Zorro II board is read and written at the address its guest gave it; the micro-ROMs never run the autoconfig chain.

0114-expansion-clear-keeps-clean-pages.why: expansion_clear skips the pages that are already zero (a snapshot carries every dirty page); the contents are the same.

0144-fpu-exception-ends-the-instruction.why: FPU exceptions end the instruction of the CE020 handler; the corpus has no FPU case.

0145-fpu-quotient-pointer-type.why: The FMOD/FREM quotient goes through a uint64_t; identical where both types are the same.

0190-filesys-rdb-checksum-bounded.why: The checksum of an RDB block sums the longs that were read; only a hard file with a hostile block reaches it.

0331-disk-raw-track-tail.why: Zeroes the bits past the end of a raw track of the extended ADF, which the drive never reads: only a disk with a raw track whose length is not a multiple of 16 bits reaches it, and the REF01 corpus has none.

0341-blitter-channel-mask-restore.why: Preserves the BLTX channel mask only when restore_blitter_new rebuilds derived state. The REF01 corpus never loads a state, so the uninterrupted execution is identical; the synthetic pending BLTCON0 write captures the restored difference.

0342-denise-nearest-sprite-sentinel.why: The no-future-sprite counter is derived and neither a negative value below SPRITE_NEAREST_MIN nor its unscaled positive sentinel can trigger matching before the next recomputation. Real distances are unchanged. The dedicated SuperHires pre/post frontend observations and sanitized arithmetic fixture cover the case outside the default corpus.

0348-collision-level-bitplane-table.why: The reference corpus uses the unchanged default Full level. Only reduced levels change: None previously leaked CLXDAT bit 0, while Sprites and Playfields leaked that same bit.

0355-cdrom-mode1-sync.why: CD sources and cdrom.cpp are not selected in the REF01 machine profiles. Only the new standalone CD sector reader calls the encoder; its independent ECMA-130 sync/header/EDC oracle captures the correction.

0350-z3-physical-autoconfig-state.why: The reference corpus has no Z3 board. Only a guest-configured Z3 board changes its recorded base/access masks, and the native-state accessors gain its mapping and window.

0356-cue-metadata-only.why: blkdev_cdimage.cpp is not selected by REF01 profiles. The metadata-only branch reuses the pinned directive traversal without the device; standalone parser checks cover strict bounds and preservation of indices, flags and gaps.

0357-ccd-metadata-only.why: blkdev_cdimage.cpp is excluded from REF01 profiles. CCD/CUE metadata-only exports are exercised by the standalone parser probe, without selecting the device backend.

0361-nrg-metadata-only.why: blkdev_cdimage.cpp is excluded from REF01 profiles. The standalone metadata endpoint reuses parsenrg without its device backend; directed DAO fixtures cover sizes, offsets and unsupported variants.

0367-cd32-combined-firmware.why: REF01 profiles contain no CD32. Only the private stock CD32 profile takes the new one-MiB combined firmware branch; other ROM envelopes are unchanged.

0376-frestore040-unimp-fields.why: REF01 does not offer CPU040. The directed fpp probe restores independently built rev40/41 UNIMP frames, checks fields, arithmetic priority, bus accesses and subsequent instructions.

0377-frestore040-busy-pending.why: REF01 offers no CPU040. Independent rev40/41 BUSY frames exercise full bus reads, field retention, FSAVE and E3/E1 priority before CU; private and P6CP codec probes cover backend reinitialization.

0378-frestore040-cu-exception-address.why: REF01 has no CPU040. The directed probe resumes independently constructed FPSP denormal FDIV frames, checks1/3 and the new exception FPIAR, actual vector/CPU retry stack and following FSAVE.FPIARCU for rev40/41.

0379-frestore040-fpsp-cu06-extended.why: REF01 has no CPU040. The directed probe constructs the rev40 CU06 extended frame from MotorolaFPSP and checks independent arithmetic, both ETE14 values, compare/test without register writes, new INEX2 and E3 priority.

0380-fsave040-sqrt-command-stage.why: REF01 has no CPU040. Actual FSQRT/FSSQRT/FDSQRT and FMOVE/FSMOVE/FDMOVE with INEX2, plus SQRT OPERR, test independent commands, stage and length for rev40/41, FRESTORE and private state after backend reset.

0382-sprite-restore-unsigned-words.why: REF01 has no native sprite-state restore. The directed real-function fixture covers high bits in32/64-bit words; native Brian6500 restore exposes the four overwrittenSPR0 bytes without changing the oracle.

0384-integer-fline-040-060.why: REF01 has no CPU040/060. Directed public instruction fixtures exercise cache maintenance, MOVE16 data and LPSTOP wakeup/restore while absent PMMU/FPU remain F-line; authorized firmware exposes the CINVA bootstrap regression.

0385-reset-registers-before-fmode.why: REF01 does not reload an AGA session after nonzero FMODE. The directed real CD32 cold-session reproducer differs at units23..74 before the fix; restore remains a separate gate.

0386-frestore040-fpsp-cu06-double-normal.why: REF01 has no FRESTORE040. Directed real decoder fixtures use independent arithmetic, all FPn, source-sign/exponent limits, compare/test without writeback and exception priority. This does not claim complete BUSY040 restoration.

0387-frestore040-fpsp-cu06-zero-infinity.why: REF01 has no FRESTORE040. Directed independent signed-zero/infinity frames cover results/flags, E3 priority and newly enabled DZ/OPERR with destination unchanged. NaNs, denormals and general BUSY completion remain pending.

keep.0359-cda-semantic-stream: The portable cd_audio_state header layout and its audio.cpp implementation must remain paired. REF01 retains this component endpoint; its corpus creates no CDA stream, while the directed PCM probe exercises the new pause and restoration behavior.
keep.0383-state-pending-config: BEAM endpoint word count must remain paired with bridge/state_upstream.cpp. The preference countdown is causal even under fixed preferences; native early-cut and real CD32 cross-owner restore exercise it. REF01 does not load native states.
